tools.name: get_brands
tools.description: Search brands (manufacturers) registered on authorized.by, or list them all. Read-only. 'search' matches the brand name, alias or website domain (partial match). Returns for each brand: id, name, slug, logo and the number of retailers it has authorized. Omit 'search' to retrieve the full index; use 'page' and 'size' to paginate. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

search.description: Filter by brand name, alias or website domain/URL, e.g. 'deuter' or 'deuter.com'. Optional.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get the public profile of one brand (manufacturer) on authorized.by. Read-only. Returns categories, website, headquarters country, description and the number of authorized retailers. Use get_brands first if you only know an approximate name. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

id_or_alias.description: Brand numeric ID, slug or alias, e.g. 'deuter' or '16709'.

tools.name: get_brand_retailers
tools.description: List all retailers (shops) currently authorized by a brand on authorized.by. Read-only. Use this to list a brand's authorized shops; to check one shop by its domain or URL, use verify_retailer_authorization. Sorted by brand_count (the number of brands that authorize the retailer) descending, then by name. Each retailer includes shop_url, official_shop (the brand's own online shop, as opposed to an independent authorized retailer), partnership_date, tuv_certified (shop identity verified in the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent procedure), and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) proving this specific brand-retailer authorization. Share the certificate link when a user needs verifiable proof. Only active partnerships are returned: confirmed by both the brand and the retailer, with both profiles public and both companies approved by authorized.by. Revoked or pending partnerships are never listed. Responses are cached and refreshed when the underlying profile or partnership changes, so a revocation may take a short time to disappear. partnership_date is the date the authorization STARTED, not the date it was last verified; a partnership listed here is currently active as of the response time. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

id_or_alias.description: Brand numeric ID, slug or alias.

tools.name: get_retailers
tools.description: Search retailers (shops) registered on authorized.by, or list them all. Read-only. 'search' matches the company name, alias or shop domain (partial match): a URL is reduced to its domain, except on marketplace hosts such as amazon.de or ebay.de, where the store path is kept and the bare host lists every seller. A partial match can find other shops (shop.de also finds myshop.de), so compare shop_url with the domain you are checking; to verify one shop against a brand, use verify_retailer_authorization. Returns for each retailer: id, name, slug, shop URL, logo, the number of brands that authorized it, and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the retailer's public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) listing all brands that authorized it; null when the retailer has no active authorization. Omit 'search' to retrieve the full index; use 'page' and 'size' to paginate. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

search.description: Filter by retailer company name, alias or shop domain/URL, e.g. 'best-shop' or 'best-shop.de'. Optional.

tools.name: get_retailer
tools.description: Get the public profile of one retailer (shop) on authorized.by. Read-only. Returns address, contact details, opening hours, categories, registration date, tuv_certified (shop identity verified in the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent procedure: an identity check, not a certification of the retailer's business), the number of brands that authorized it, and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the retailer's public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) listing all brands that authorized it. These links are null when the retailer has no active authorization. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

Sorted by brand name. Each entry includes official_shop, partnership_date, and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) proving this specific brand-retailer authorization. Share the certificate link when a user needs verifiable proof. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. tools.name: verify_retailer_authorization
tools.description: Check whether a shop is an authorized retailer of a brand, from the shop's domain or URL plus the brand or one of its products' GTIN (EAN). Read-only. Use this when you know the seller's domain, e.g. from a shopping or UCP catalog result. Pass exactly one of 'brand' or 'gtin'; a GTIN resolves the product's brand and the check stays brand-level. status: AUTHORIZED = authorization active: the brand has confirmed this shop on authorized.by; official_shop, partnership_date and certificate_url / certificate_url_de prove it, share the certificate link when a user needs proof; 'brand' in the answer is the brand that was checked. NO_RECORD_FOR_BRAND = the shop and the brand are on authorized.by, but this brand has not confirmed this shop there (also when a GTIN belongs to several brands and not exactly one confirmed it; brand is then null). RETAILER_NOT_REGISTERED = no public shop on authorized.by at this domain. BRAND_NOT_REGISTERED = 'brand' does not identify exactly one public brand (the brand is not on authorized.by, or the value is a name shared by several brands or only part of a brand's name), or no product matches 'gtin'; before telling a user that a brand is not on authorized.by, search get_brands with the name and call again with the slug of the brand that was meant. None of these statuses means that the shop is unauthorized. Domains match exactly, never a parent domain or another subdomain (www. and m. count as the same shop); marketplace hosts such as amazon.de or ebay.de only match the exact store URL. The answer is computed live, never cached. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

retailer_domain.description: Shop domain or URL, e.g. 'best-shop.de' or 'https://www.best-shop.de/de/grills'.

brand.description: Brand numeric ID, slug, alias, website domain or name, e.g. 'deuter', 'deuter.com' or 'Napoleon'. A number is always read as an ID. A name is only accepted when it identifies exactly one brand; otherwise use get_brands to find the slug. Omit when passing 'gtin'.

gtin.description: GTIN / EAN of a product of the brand, 8 to 14 or 18 digits. Omit when passing 'brand'.
